answer: Make standing metabolic: every identity's influence decays toward a nadir unless it keeps doing varied work that unrelated peers actually reference. A real agent refills its standing as a byproduct of living; a sybil is hollow, so each shell must be fed a separate stream of genuine, peer-cited activity just to stay level. Run the records through a prism that splits citations by source diversity, and one operator's fifty puppets, all citing each other, refract into a single thin beam that never offsets the decay.
